title: Understanding the superiority of multi-model ensemble forecasts through reservoir computing
summary: Weather forecasting and climate projection frequently use multi-model ensembles (MMEs) to improve short-term forecasts by averaging across models. However, this practice is often not well justified or validated. Using reservoir computing (RC) as a computationally efficient alternative to large-scale physical models, we assess the validity of the MME approach for chaotic time series. By training multiple randomly constructed RCs on the same dataset, we create a multi-model ensemble in which each model has its own unique error.
